headline: Strong Revenue Growth; Input Cost Inflation Weighs on Margins

highlights: Key Points  Revenue beat; RM inflation weighs on margins: Revenue grew 16.6% YoY (+7.7% QoQ) to Rs79.7bn, 1.0%/0.6% ahead of NBIE/consensus, led by 25.6% YoY growth in India.
EBITDA fell 16.2% YoY to Rs8.55bn, with margin down by 421bps YoY to 10.7% (-100bps QoQ), as a steep rise in the RM basket outpaced price hikes; EBITDA was 4.9%/7.1% below NBIE/consensus.

PAT declined 27.2% YoY to Rs3.19bn, 3.6% above NBIE but 7.7% below consensus.  Outlook: Management expects 3QFY27 volume growth to moderate to mid-to-high single digits on a higher base, with pricing contributing more towards revenue growth.

The RM basket should rise by a further mid-to- high single digit QoQ in 3Q, tentatively peaking towards the end of FY27; cumulative price hikes of 13-15% by October remain short of the 16-17% required, and no firm margin-recovery timeline was given.
valuation: FY27 capex is guided at >Rs30bn (H1: ~Rs15bn), with Europe operational stability expected in FY28.  Valuation: We maintain HOLD with a revised TP of Rs469 (Rs458 earlier), valuing the stock at 14x Sep-28E EPS.
Management acknowledged possible near-term RoCE pressure but retained its mid-teens steady-state target.
H1 capex was approximately Rs15,000 million; the management acknowledged possible near-term ROCE pressure while retaining a mid-teens steady-state target.
